messages:
micah (PM): Quick sync — final GA readiness for Launch X. Need clear SLAs, docs, support runbooks, monitoring dashboards, and pricing appendix by EOD Thu. Target GA in ~2 weeks. Can we validate?/

olivia (sales): Two asks from field: (1) Pricing tiers (Standard / Enterprise) with enterprise SLA and onboarding. (2) Early customers want a 6-month pilot discount. Also Customer A asked for 99.95% — can we commit?/

sam (sre): Proposal: Hosted API SLA = 99.95% monthly; P99 latency target = 350ms (1k token baseline). Dedicated customers: 99.99% with reserved capacity and documented failover. We need burn-in + 48h soak + synthetic canary to prove it.

anya (eng): Perf update: running full-load tests now. Two blockers: kv-cache warmup causes P99 spikes on cold routes; quantized model variants reduce some prompt quality. Will add router fallback to smaller model variant and an aggressive KV pre-warm for GA. Need perf signoff by EOD tomorrow.

kevin (docs): Docs plan: Quickstart (hosted + dedicated), SLA explainer page, Support runbooks (P1/P2 handling), and a latency/throughput expectations table. I need the SRE SLO snippet and a sample error flow to finish runbooks. ETA: initial drafts by tomorrow morning.

sam (sre): Here's a minimal SLO snippet you can embed in the docs:
```yaml
slo:
  name: hosted-p99-latency
  target: 0.995   # 99.5% of requests under objective_ms in the window
  window: 30d
  objective_ms: 350
alerts:
  - name: p99-latency-alert
    threshold: 0.99  # fire if rolling target falls below 99%
    action: pager-duty -> oncall
```
Use this for the SLA page; we can expand per-tier.

rachel (support): Support scope: 24/7 oncall for enterprise customers (P1s), business-hours for self-serve to start. Need a playbook for "high p99 latency": steps to verify routing, check cache warmup, escalate to eng with traces and sample request. Can SRE produce runbook skeleton?

anya (eng): Will produce a short troubleshooting checklist and include router config flags: fallback_model, serve_from_cache, degrade_streaming. Also adding automatic fallback to prior model variant for 5 retries before escalation.

olivia (sales): Also request: a short "what we promise" one-pager for sales decks (SLA, onboarding timeline, expected latencies). And confirm billing language for pilot discounts.

jordan (legal): For Private deployments we need a data residency clause and SOC2 appendix in contracts. Provide template language and approved auditor list — I can draft today but need product to confirm behavior for logs and telemetry retention.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: GA candidate build scheduled: 2026-04-02T09:00Z — will run canary group after perf signoff.

micah (PM): Plan of record: agree SLA targets above (hosted 99.95% / p99 350ms; dedicated 99.99%), docs + runbook drafts by EOD Thu, perf signoff tomorrow, pricing appendix + sales one-pager by Fri. Owners: Anya (eng) — perf/runbook; Sam (SRE) — SLOs/monitoring; Kevin (Docs) — writeups; Olivia (Sales) — pricing appendix; Jordan (Legal) — contract clauses; Rachel (Support) — oncall ops. I'll consolidate and send a follow-up with owners and milestones. :thumbsup:
